answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with locked capital, creating a velvet barrier against identity proliferation. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces a gale of economic pressure, as the cost to acquire sufficient stake exceeds the marginal utility of the attack. By requiring this bridge between digital participation and tangible financial risk, the protocol ensures that subverting consensus is prohibitively expensive.
